claims.content: To record the distribution of vouchers to distributors and clients, capturing sales details for tracking and reporting purposes.

goal.raw_text: To record the distribution of vouchers to distributors and clients, capturing sales details for tracking and reporting purposes.

claims.content: VMU User
The user must be logged in with appropriate permissions to access the distributor screen and perform actions like adding new records.
The system must have a master table structure set up to manage distributor details including geographical location information.
The database must be properly configured with sequential links and surrogate keys for efficient data management.

The VMU User initiates the recording of voucher distribution by accessing the distributor screen to enter or update sales details, such as batch number, date of purchase, quantity purchased, sold, returned, and balance quantity.

trigger.raw_text: The VMU User initiates the recording of voucher distribution by accessing the distributor screen to enter or update sales details, such as batch number, date of purchase, quantity purchased, sold, returned, and balance quantity.

claims.content: The VMU User accesses the distributor screen to record voucher distribution details.
The system captures geographical location of the distributor (District, Sub-District, County, etc.) using master table structure for consistency.
The user enters sales details including Batch No, Date of purchase, Qty Purchase, Qty Sold, Qty Returned, and Balance Qty.
The system checks for duplicated ID for distributors; if duplicate name is entered, it issues a warning message allowing user to keep or change the name.
The system saves the voucher distribution record only if all mandatory fields are completed and no validation errors exist.
The system updates the Database with the new sales details, linking to Voucher Creation and Claim Processing modules as shown in Functional Flow Diagram.
The system enables viewing of Sales History for the particular distributor via double-clicking on the grid.
If the user attempts to create a User Group or Individual User with an existing name, the system shall not allow it.
If the Password and Verify Password values are not equal during user creation, the system shall not save the user information.
If the user attempts to delete a record that has child records created, the system shall not allow deletion.
If the user attempts to print a report without having the required User Login Permission, the system shall deny the print option.
The voucher distribution record is saved in the database with all mandatory fields completed, including Batch No, Date of purchase, Qty Purchase, Qty Sold, Qty Returned, and Balance Qty.
The Sales History for the particular distributor is updated and available for viewing via double-clicking on the grid.
The Database is updated to reflect the new sales details, maintaining links to Voucher Creation and Claim Processing modules as per the Functional Flow Diagram.
If a duplicate distributor name was entered, the system has either retained it with a warning or allowed the user to change it, ensuring data integrity for reporting purposes.
